review.notes: Independent source-evidence re-review verified 4 frozen Git blobs and exact SHA-256 values at 6dc1858538e3b7ea66b78dd9d37c391c530d78ae. Independent review confirms npm 11.6.3, the root lock, npm ci, and active Ubuntu CI on the .nvmrc Node 24 line. The tree never fixes a Node patch, so candidate Node 24.16.0 cannot be authenticated against the February 2026 base without an exact Linux x64 probe; status remains draft.

sourceEvidence.statement: Frozen Ubuntu CI resolves .nvmrc and runs npm ci from the repository root.
Frozen .nvmrc selects the Node 24 line but deliberately does not authenticate an exact patch.
Frozen root npm lockfile is bound for the repository's npm ci preparation.
Root manifest pins npm 11.6.3 with integrity metadata and defines the workspaces consumed by the root lock.
